query:
UPDATE redistricting_states
SET
  enacted = 0,
  reason = 'Procedural constitutional violation — amendment approved after 2025 HOD elections began',
  status = 'Struck Down',
  method = 'Voter referendum (nullified by court)',
  delegation_before = '6 D - 5 R',
  projected_impact = 'None — current 6-5 Democratic maps remain in effect through 2030',
  litigation_notes = 'VIRGINIA SUPREME COURT RULING — May 8, 2026 (4-3): The Supreme Court of Virginia struck down the April 21, 2026 redistricting amendment in a 4-3 ruling, affirming a lower Tazewell County court decision. The majority, written by Justice D. Arthur Kelsey, found that the General Assembly approved the amendment after voting had already begun in the 2025 House of Delegates elections, denying over 1.3 million Virginians their constitutional right to weigh in on the proposal. Article XII, Section 1 of the Virginia Constitution requires an intervening general election between the legislature''s first and second approvals of a constitutional amendment. The proposed maps would have shifted Virginia''s congressional delegation from 6-5 Democratic to a potential 10-1 Democratic advantage. With the ruling, the current maps remain in place for 2026 and the rest of the decade. Virginia AG Jay Jones criticized the ruling and Democrats have filed to appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court, though legal experts say success is unlikely. Sources: Virginia Mercury · NPR Politics · PBS NewsHour (May 8, 2026)'
WHERE state_code = 'VA';

UPDATE referendums
SET
  status = 'Certified',
  called_result = 'No',
  notes = 'RESULT VOIDED BY VIRGINIA SUPREME COURT (May 8, 2026, 4-3): Voters approved this amendment 51%-49% on April 21, 2026, but the Supreme Court of Virginia struck it down in a 4-3 ruling on May 8, 2026. The court found the amendment was procedurally invalid because the General Assembly approved it after voting had already begun in the 2025 House of Delegates elections, violating Article XII, Section 1 of the Virginia Constitution. The current congressional maps (6-5 Democratic) remain in place. Democrats are considering an appeal to the U.S. Supreme Court. Sources: Virginia Mercury · NPR Politics (May 8, 2026)'
WHERE state_code = 'VA';
